ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_pairwise_ranked_sigmoid_advantage_decay
ir.intuition: This loss applies a sigmoid transformation to the difference in log probabilities, which is then re-weighted by an exponentially decayed function of the rank gap derived from advantage signals. It encourages the model to focus more on pairs with larger advantage differences while softly penalizing smaller differences, promoting smooth rank-aware preference learning.
ir.pseudocode:
rank_gap = abs(rank(advantage_w) - rank(advantage_l))
weight_decay = exp(-decay_rate * rank_gap)
sigmoid_score = sigmoid(log_prob_w - log_prob_l)
raw_loss = (1 - sigmoid_score) * weight * weight_decay
final_loss = mean(raw_loss)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))
    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']
    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']
    decay_rate = float(extra.get('decay_rate', 0.5))

    gap_rank = ops.abs(ops.rank_gap(adv_w, adv_l))
    weight_decay = ops.exp(ops.neg(ops.mul(decay_rate, gap_rank)))

    score_diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    sigmoid_score = ops.sigmoid(score_diff)

    loss_raw = ops.mul(ops.sub(ops.ones_like(sigmoid_score), sigmoid_score), weight)
    loss_weighted = ops.mul(loss_raw, weight_decay)

    return ops.mean(loss_weighted)
